messages:
owen: Heads up — opened PR #7421 for the authz connector changes that wire up HSM-backed keys and the new auditmetadata hook. Would appreciate eyes before the weekly merge window. https://git.internal/redwood/inference/pull/7421 :eyes:
maria: I'll take a look this afternoon, ping me if you want a quick call. Key concerns: KMS fallback behavior and auditlog schema compatibility.
ashley: skimmed the diff — main flow looks ok. left one comment about error handling when HSM unreachable (we should not block reads).
sam: quick note: CI failed one flaky test in e2e-authz, re-running. can someone confirm the migration script for key IDs is idempotent?
ownen: @sam CI is red now but it's a flaky timing thing, re-run should pass. The migration script has a guard to skip existing key entries, it's in scripts/migrate_hsm_keys.sh — see line 42.
ashley: copied snippet:
```
if [ -z "$(db get key $KEY_ID)" ]; then
  db insert key $KEY_ID --hsm-ref=$HSM_ID
else
  echo "key exists, skipping"
fi
```
so it should be safe.
maria: two high-level asks from security side: 1) add a feature flag so we can toggle HSM mode per-tenant; 2) audit log must include key origin (kms|hsm) and rotation id. Can you add both?
ownen: good call — I can add the flag and audit fields. it's behind feature flag 'hsm_rollout'.
ownen: also calling out risk: if KMS and HSM disagree on active key, we currently prefer HSM. we might want a reconciliation job.
ashley: +1 on reconciliation. Also we need SRE signoff for the extra latency (HSM call adds ~30-60ms) — @sam can you run perf on dedicated capacity?
sam: will run a small perf job this evening and paste numbers. rough expectation is +40ms p95 for token signing, but batching should hide some of that.
security-bot: CI status: tests/authorization (e2e-authz) — rerun queued, expected finish in ~10m.
ownen: @maria added stub audit fields and the feature flag in the latest commit, and a migration dry-run output in the PR description.
maria: thanks. I left nit comments and one blocking comment about KMS policy changes not included — we need a policy update PR or a note for reviewers to confirm no policy gaps.
ownen: noted, I'll open a POLICIES-issue and link it.
ashley: LGTM with the HSM unreachable handling fixed and policies link added. :+1:
sam: perf numbers: p50 +8ms, p95 +42ms on a 4-GPU dedicated pool with 1000 req/s synthetic load. looks within SLA but SLO owners should confirm.
ownen: thanks, I'll drop those numbers in the PR and in the rollout checklist. planning to target merge tomorrow 09:00 PT after final approvals.
maria: I'll approve after the policy note and the reconciliation job issue.
ownen: bumping for visibility — can we get one more approver? @ashley?
ashley: approved after fix I requested.
ownen: all approvals obtained, merging tomorrow unless there's an objection. I'll coordinate a canary rollout to 5% of traffic and monitor audit spikes.
security-bot: deploy scheduled: canary rollout plan set for 2026-03-18 09:00 PT, CPU/latency alerts attached.
ownen: thanks everyone — will post follow-up in #eng-oncall once canary is live.
maria: thanks for the quick turnaround. :tada:
